crossRefs.note: Moreover as for me, far be it from me that I should sin against Yahweh in ceasing to pray for you: but I will instruct…
May it never be! For then how will God judge the world?
May it never be! We who died to sin, how could we live in it any longer?
But the righteous will live by faith. If he shrinks back, my soul has no pleasure in him.”
But we are not of those who shrink back to destruction, but of those who have faith to the saving of the soul.

translations.web: The people answered, “Far be it from us that we should forsake Yahweh, to serve other gods;
translations.bsb: The people replied, “Far be it from us to forsake the LORD to serve other gods!
translations.kjv: And the people answered and said, God forbid that we should forsake the LORD, to serve other gods;
translations.asv: And the people answered and said, Far be it from us that we should forsake Jehovah, to serve other gods;
